content.text: ▪︎inflammation of myocardium w/ necrosis of myocytes
▪︎major cause of sudden cardiac death in adults <40yo
: flu-like SXS (e.g., fever, myalgia, arthralgia, fatigue)
tachycardia out of proportion to fever
), HF SXS (e.g., dyspnea, S3, edema, JVD, crackles)
: pleuritic chest pain relieved by sitting up/leaning forward, pericardial friction rub
myocardium w/ necrosis of adjacent myocytes
worse when supine & w/ deep inspiration & relieved w/ sitting up/leaning forward
the LSB w/ patient upright & leaning forward
